title: resolutions.v1
description: Capability `resolutions` (SPEC.md section 4.3): the seam by which another module (for example `equity` grants that need board approval) asks for a board resolution and reads its outcome. A request creates a draft resolution; the company secretary completes and runs it; the outcome is pending, approved, rejected or cancelled and carries ids and a date only. Event: board.resolution.passed.v1. Provided by the in-house board module. THIS IS A TOOL, NOT LEGAL ADVICE: jurisdiction-specific rules (quorum and notice law, who must sign, which registers a company must keep, filing deadlines, director duties) are not implemented; they are data fields the operator enters and documented limits. Only the integration role (the can-core service account) may call these verbs. A person the decision is about who sits on the body is recused automatically and the requester cannot be the sole approver.

x-verbs.description: Creates (or returns) a draft resolution for another module's decision; the secretary completes and runs it. A subject who is a director is recused automatically; the requester cannot be the sole approver.
Query: type, ref. pending, approved, rejected or cancelled; ids and a date only.
